title: A Trail for the Provision
author: Yara Almeida
blurb: Jude Eriksen, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
